scene: You crouch by the rocket's brass dial and sparking ignition key.
picture: Close-up first-person view of the rocket's control panel. On the left, a tarnished brass key rests turned off inside an ignition slot. In the centre, an orange-lit circular pressure gauge with a notched dial sits ticking. On the right, a glowing blue chemical vial is clamped into a copper bracket.
shown: A brass key sticking out of a copper keyhole on the left
A notched glass pressure dial glowing orange in the rocket's centre
A bubbling blue chemical phial clipped to the right side

variants.scene: The metal panel hums as glowing blue liquid bubbles beside the warm gauge.
Tiny sparks glitter near the key while the glowing center dial ticks softly.
Your hands steady against the rocket as the strange blue tube gurgles.
